title: Notion Knowledge Hub
description: My Notion notes on system design, databases and programming.

title: When the Gateway Times Out: Idempotent Payment Design
description: A ₦50,000 withdrawal times out at the gateway. The money may already have left, but your system says FAILED. How to design payouts so a timeout never pays twice or loses funds, and how to reconcile afterwards.

title: How Not to Buy a Scammer Coffee
description: Card testing, multi-account abuse and the other fraud we saw on a live payments app, and the checks we built to stop each one.

title: How We Built a Hybrid WebRTC Calling System Inside a Mobile WebView
description: PopnChat runs inside a mobile WebView, where WebRTC calls break. Why we wrote the WebRTC logic twice (TypeScript and Java), kept signaling in JS while native code handled the media, and the bugs that only showed up on real phones.

title: The Floating-Point Bomb: Why Your Finance App Is Probably Losing Money
description: If your app stores money as floating-point numbers, rounding errors are already creeping into wallets, refunds and audits. Store amounts as integer kobo or cents, and do the conversion in one place.
